relationship_between_churches.enmity_reason: Driven by the Above the Sequence in-group rivalry. The fall of all adjacent pathways' gods is necessary for the rise of a Great Old One.
relationship_between_churches.jurisdiction: In the Loen Kingdom that featured polytheism, the principle of jurisdiction over Beyonder events was first to divide them according to the beliefs of the victims. If they involved followers of multiple deities, then it would be decided according to who held jurisdiction over the area.

specific_relationships.Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun: Poor relationship with Church of the Lord of Storms and Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom. They see each other as enemies.
specific_relationships.Church of the Lord of Storms: Poor relationship with Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun and Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom. They see each other as enemies.
specific_relationships.Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdo: Poor relationship with Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun and Church of the Lord of Storms. They see each other as enemies.
specific_relationships.Church of the Evernight Goddess: At odds with the Church of the God of Combat from the Feysac Empire.

gender_roles_perspectives.Church of the Earth Mother: Similar to the Church of the Evernight Goddess, believes women should have the same standing as men. Places more emphasis on reproduction, treating it as the holiest matter.
gender_roles_perspectives.Church of the Evernight Goddess: Believes women should have the same standing as men.
gender_roles_perspectives.Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun: Next biased towards men, but has high-ranking women and at least one female Angel.
gender_roles_perspectives.Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdo: Discriminates based on intelligence, different from other Churches.
gender_roles_perspectives.Church of the God of Steam and Machinery: Neutral, has worked with the Church of the Evernight Goddess to encourage women to work due to industrial labor needs.

powers_and_artifacts.information_exchange: The Seven Orthodox Churches formed a uniform naming convention for Sealed Artifacts. They exchange information regarding Grade 0 and Grade 1, telling each other which ones they possess, so code names won't be repeated. Grade 2 and Grade 3 are arranged by respective churches.

church_assets.orthodox_churches: Own 5 to 8 Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, and fewer than 4 grounded Angels in each church.
church_assets.church_of_the_fool_1352: City of Silver: A Sequence 3 saint, three Sequence 4 saints, nearly ten Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, and a few demigod Beyonder characteristics. Moon City: Three demigods, five Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts. Combined equivalent to a quarter of the Church of Storms. The Church of Storms has around 20 Saints.

hierarchy_positions.Pope (教宗): Leader of Church of the Evernight Goddess and Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
hierarchy_positions.Pontiff (教皇): Leader of Church of the Lord of Storms and Church of the Sea God.
hierarchy_positions.Matriarch (主母): Leader of Church of the Earth Mother.
hierarchy_positions.Chief Shepherd (大牧首): Leader of Church of the God of Combat.
hierarchy_positions.Cardinals: Advisers to the Patriarch and electors of the next Patriarch.
hierarchy_positions.Bishops: Responsible for overseeing a single diocese.
hierarchy_positions.Priests: Serve as spiritual leaders of individual parishes.
hierarchy_positions.High-ranking Deacons: Sequence 4 and higher Beyonders loyal to the Church.

trivia.address_respect: In various Churches, if a demigod at the angel level walked the land, they are addressed as 'Your Eminence'. Towards the pontiff, pope, and chief shepherd - representatives of the deities - one uses 'Your Holiness'.
trivia.rose_school_of_thought: Formerly an orthodox organization in the Southern Continent, ruling the Paz Valley and Star Highlands where the government and church were one.
